headline: CICC Seeks Broader Authority Over Messaging and Livestreaming Platforms After Zamboanga Shooting
seoTitle: CICC Seeks Broader Messaging, Livestreaming Oversight | FMB News
seoDescription: The CICC is seeking expanded regulatory authority over messaging and livestreaming platforms following concerns about circulation of violent content after the Zamboanga school shooting.
deck: The cybercrime agency is pushing for stronger tools to address violent livestreams and harmful digital circulation involving minors.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center is seeking expanded regulatory jurisdiction over messaging and livestreaming platforms, according to the approved FMB News midday package.

The proposal follows concerns over the online circulation of violent footage linked to the Zamboanga campus shooting and the speed at which harmful content can spread across private messaging and live-broadcast services.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The CICC coordinates cybercrime policy and inter-agency response, but platform governance also involves other regulators, law-enforcement bodies and existing laws on cybercrime, data privacy and child protection.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Any expansion of government authority over digital platforms raises two issues at once: faster protection against violent or exploitative content, and the need for clear legal safeguards for privacy, due process and lawful expression.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch Congress for the exact scope of any proposed amendments, including takedown powers, platform obligations, reporting standards, safeguards and judicial or regulatory oversight.
